from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json
import hashlib
import re
import traceback
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

r=Path.cwd()
out=r/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_business_expectation_joint_source_v1"
at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,d):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("产物已存在，禁止覆盖："+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p)}
def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+","",str(s)).replace("\u3000","")
def aware(s):
    if s is None or pd.isna(s):
        return pd.NaT
    t=pd.Timestamp(s)
    return (t.tz_localize("Asia/Shanghai") if t.tzinfo is None else t).tz_convert("UTC")
protocol=json.loads((out/"protocol_source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
assert sha(out/"protocol_source.json")=="f553b2fcb699d163a4db7f443f173e1108bc2f8d7a9d9c88fe0f2aa6ee4136d0"
if (out/"RUN_STARTED_SOURCE.json").exists():
    raise RuntimeError("已实际开始过，不能无理由再运行")
save("RUN_STARTED_SOURCE.json",{"at":at,"scope":"原132当前原量及全原训练支持；不读net_label/open/close","new_queries":0,"new_GETs":0,"new_fits":0})
try:
    anchors_path=r/"reports/research/510300_factor96_rapid_orders_inventory_v1/source_fields_and_anchors.json"
    core_path=r/"reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet"
    pools_path=r/"reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json"
    anchors_hash=sha(anchors_path)
    core_hash=sha(core_path)
    pools_hash=sha(pools_path)
    assert anchors_hash=="75ba1786293d4b6edbbacba90a31620f433e2d41bf66f41306ff9335f84fd579"
    assert core_hash=="c6be6dcf35dbff5f162980115de43acc498a15c0bd116b0f003d009c7ec712e7"
    assert pools_hash=="2edb4d5dc05c51cc64ca2c53be66af971af33ce44c88aa67cd2ddf702734eb32"
    parents=json.loads(anchors_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    assert len(parents)==132
    monthly=[]
    all_raw_refs=[]
    for parent in parents:
        p=r/parent["raw_path"]
        actual_hash=sha(p)
        if actual_hash!=parent["raw_sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("固定原月报已变化："+parent["stat_month"])
        all_raw_refs.append({"stat_month":parent["stat_month"],"path":parent["raw_path"],"sha256":actual_hash})
        parent_labels={norm(a["current_month_row"][0]) for a in parent["anchors"] if a["key"]=="new_orders"}
        assert len(parent_labels)==1,"原当前月份锚不唯一"
        current_label=next(iter(parent_labels))
        soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),"html.parser")
        found=[]
        mismatches=[]
        for ti,table in enumerate(soup.find_all("table")):
            rows=table.find_all("tr")
            for hi,row in enumerate(rows):
                headers=[norm(c.get_text(" ",strip=True)) for c in row.find_all(["th","td"],recursive=False)]
                hits=[j for j,v in enumerate(headers) if v=="生产经营活动预期"]
                if len(headers)<6 or len(hits)!=1 or not any(v=="采购量" for v in headers) or not any(v=="在手订单" for v in headers):
                    continue
                col=hits[0]
                for ri,datarow in enumerate(rows[hi+1:],start=hi+1):
                    cells=[norm(c.get_text(" ",strip=True)) for c in datarow.find_all(["th","td"],recursive=False)]
                    if not cells or cells[0]!=current_label:
                        continue
                    offset=0 if len(cells)==len(headers) else 1 if len(cells)==len(headers)+1 and headers[0] not in ["","月份","时间","日期"] else None
                    if offset is None or col+offset>=len(cells):
                        mismatches.append({"table_index":ti,"row_index":ri,"headers":headers,"current_month_row":cells,"reason":"原表列长无法唯一对齐"})
                        continue
                    token=cells[col+offset]
                    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)?",token):
                        mismatches.append({"table_index":ti,"row_index":ri,"reason":"原预期单元格不是唯一原数字","token":token})
                        continue
                    found.append({"table_index":ti,"header_row_index":hi,"row_index":ri,"header":headers,
                        "current_month_row":cells,"value_column":col+offset,"value":float(token)})
        values={a["value"] for a in found}
        okay=bool(found) and len(values)==1 and not mismatches
        value=next(iter(values)) if okay else None
        if okay and not (0<=value<=100):
            okay=False
            value=None
        monthly.append({"stat_month":parent["stat_month"],"published_at":parent["published_at"],"available_at":parent["known_at"],
            "business_expectation":value,"制造业经营预期原水平":value,"new_orders_same_source":parent["new_orders"],
            "method_group":parent["method_group"],"source_url":parent["source_url"],"raw_path":parent["raw_path"],"raw_sha256":actual_hash,
            "status":"KNOWN_NATIVE_CURRENT_MONTH_UNIQUE" if okay else "UNKNOWN_NATIVE_COLUMN_OR_CURRENT_ROW_AMBIGUOUS",
            "anchors":found,"alignment_failures":mismatches,"current_month_row_only":True,
            "reported_horizon":"UNKNOWN_NOT_SEPARATELY_ESTABLISHED_FROM_HEADER",
            "same_source_as_original_orders":True,"historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,
            "market_consensus_expectation":False,"actual_output_or_cash":False})
    monthlyref=save("全部132原经营预期当月唯一单元格与原钟_E121.json",{"at":at,"months":monthly,
        "all_raw_refs":all_raw_refs,"no_later_report_historical_backfill":True,"no_new_stock_labels_read":True})
    pools=json.loads(pools_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    assert len(pools)==1212
    features8=["订单水平","订单月度变化","资金利率与政策利率差","融资五日净变化","融资买入活跃度","指数趋势强度","短长波动比","成交活跃度"]
    read_columns=["idx","date","decision_time","orders_available_at"]+features8
    core=pd.read_parquet(core_path,columns=read_columns)
    assert core["idx"].is_unique
    core=core.set_index("idx",drop=False)
    required_indices=sorted(set(int(p["idx"]) for p in pools)|set(int(i) for p in pools for i in p["training_indices"]))
    training_indices=sorted(set(int(i) for p in pools for i in p["training_indices"]))
    assert all(i in core.index for i in required_indices)
    mapping={}
    for m in monthly:
        key=aware(m["available_at"])
        if key in mapping:
            raise RuntimeError("原月报有重复可知钟，不能擅自挑一份")
        mapping[key]=m
    joint=[]
    unknown=[]
    for idx in required_indices:
        old=core.loc[idx]
        available=aware(old["orders_available_at"])
        decision=aware(old["decision_time"])
        src=mapping.get(available)
        reasons=[]
        if src is None:
            reasons.append("原订单可知钟未绑定唯一原月")
        elif src["status"]!="KNOWN_NATIVE_CURRENT_MONTH_UNIQUE":
            reasons.append("原月经营预期未知")
        elif available>decision:
            reasons.append("原月来源晚于原决定")
        elif abs(float(old["订单水平"])-(float(src["new_orders_same_source"])-50))>1e-9:
            reasons.append("原订单水平与同原月原量不一致")
        row={"idx":int(idx),"date":str(pd.Timestamp(old["date"]).date()),"decision_time":str(decision),
            "orders_available_at":str(available),"经营预期来源统计月":src["stat_month"] if src else None,
            "制造业经营预期原水平":src["business_expectation"] if src and not reasons else None,
            "status":"PASS_SAME_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_CLOCK_INPUT" if not reasons else "UNKNOWN_SOURCE_SUPPORT",
            "unknown_reasons":reasons,"method_group":src["method_group"] if src else None,
            "raw_sha256":src["raw_sha256"] if src else None}
        for feature in features8:
            row[feature]=float(old[feature])
        joint.append(row)
        if reasons:
            unknown.append(row)
    joint_by_idx={row["idx"]:row for row in joint}
    support=[]
    for pool in pools:
        idx=int(pool["idx"])
        members=[int(i) for i in pool["training_indices"]]
        missing=[i for i in members if joint_by_idx[i]["status"]!="PASS_SAME_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_CLOCK_INPUT"]
        support.append({"idx":idx,"date":str(pool["date"])[:10],"original_training_members":len(members),
            "unknown_training_members":len(missing),"unknown_member_indices":missing,
            "decision_input_status":joint_by_idx[idx]["status"],"all_members_unchanged":True,
            "status":"PASS_ALL_ORIGINAL_MEMBERS_AND_DECISION" if not missing and joint_by_idx[idx]["status"]=="PASS_SAME_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_CLOCK_INPUT" else "UNKNOWN_SUPPORT"})
    jointref=save("全部原评分与原成熟身份9维来源输入_不含股票标签_E121.json",{"at":at,"columns_read":read_columns,
        "required_unique_indices":len(required_indices),"training_unique_indices":len(training_indices),"rows":joint,
        "new_candidate_feature":"制造业经营预期原水平","features8_preserved":features8,
        "net_label_open_close_equity_not_read":True})
    supportref=save("全部1212原决定与各自成熟成员_原预期来源支持_E121.json",{"at":at,"rows":support,
        "scored_dates":len(pools),"required_unique_indices":len(required_indices),"training_unique_indices":len(training_indices),
        "no_members_deleted_replaced":True,"no_labels_generated_or_read":True})
    known_months=sum(m["status"]=="KNOWN_NATIVE_CURRENT_MONTH_UNIQUE" for m in monthly)
    passed=sum(s["status"]=="PASS_ALL_ORIGINAL_MEMBERS_AND_DECISION" for s in support)
    complete=known_months==132 and passed==1212 and not unknown
    assert sha(anchors_path)==anchors_hash and sha(core_path)==core_hash and sha(pools_path)==pools_hash
    source_result={
        "at":at,"study_id":protocol["study_id"],"experiment_id":"E121",
        "status":"PASS_FULL_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_AND_COMMON_POOL_EXPLORATORY_ONLY" if complete else "CLOSED_FIXED_SOURCE_CANDIDATE_INCOMPLETE_ORIGINAL_SUPPORT",
        "source_months":132,"known_months":known_months,"UNKNOWN_months":132-known_months,
        "required_unique_input_identities":len(required_indices),"unique_training_identities":len(training_indices),
        "known_required_input_identities":len(joint)-len(unknown),"UNKNOWN_required_input_identities":len(unknown),
        "original_scored_dates":1212,"all_original_support_pass_dates":passed,
        "all_original_same_members_and_source_clock":complete,"source_admitted_for_separately_registered_exploratory_nonlinear_use":complete,
        "old_raw_source_and_core_hashes_unchanged":True,
        "new_direct_native_question_not_derived_old_inventory_signal":True,
        "limited_old_use_review_not_proof_global_exhaustion":True,
        "historical_source_already_seen_and_first2015_01_raw47_4_prepeek_disclosed":True,
        "reported_horizon":"UNKNOWN_NOT_SEPARATELY_ESTABLISHED","market_consensus":False,
        "first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,"blind_new_sample":False,
        "new_financial_information_increment":"NOT_COMPUTED_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
        "new_queries":0,"new_GETs":0,"new_fits":0,"new_linear_regressions":0,"new_weighted_scores":0,
        "new_stock_labels_read":0,"new_stock_labels_generated":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0,
        "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
        "orders_authorized":False,"prospective_forecasts":False,"evidence":[monthlyref,jointref,supportref],
        "source_protocol":{"path":rel(out/"protocol_source.json"),"sha256":sha(out/"protocol_source.json")},
        "source_only_stage_closed":True}
    save("source_result.json",source_result)
    print(json.dumps({"E121来源阶段":source_result["status"],"全部原月已知":known_months,"原月UNKNOWN":132-known_months,
        "全部原输入身份":len(required_indices),"输入UNKNOWN":len(unknown),"原1212成熟支持通过":passed,
        "新请求/拟合/股票标签/账户":0,"新直接问项":protocol["source_field"]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
except Exception:
    save("来源实际执行失败留证_E121.json",{"at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),"traceback":traceback.format_exc(),
        "new_queries":0,"new_GETs":0,"new_fits":0,"new_stock_labels":0,"new_accounts":0,"existing_source_code_edits":0})
    raise
